metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn custom Dragon Ball Z portrait from $39.99. Preview within 72 hours, with unlimited free revisions. Start yours today.
heroHeading: Power Up as Your Own DBZ-Inspired Hero
description: Bring your favourite battle-anime energy to a portrait made by a real human artist. Anime Cabinet creates each custom Dragon Ball Z portrait by hand from your photo, translating your expression, features, hairstyle, glasses, facial hair and personality into an original character with bold spiked silhouettes, dramatic poses, aura effects and classic cel-shaded impact. Choose a calm base-form look, a golden power-up atmosphere, Ultra Instinct-inspired hints or another direction that suits your personality. The result is fan-art inspired rather than a copy of a copyrighted character: you become the hero of your own story, not an impersonation of Goku, Vegeta or another existing fighter.

Ordering is simple. Upload a clear photo, label everyone included, and tell us what you want in the notes: preferred pose, aura colour, outfit inspiration, hair direction, background mood or power-up details. Action shots and flexing photos are excellent for energetic compositions, but a straightforward selfie works too. Families, couples, friends and training partners can all share one scene, with each person kept recognisable beneath the stylisation. Your artist sends a preview within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions are included so you can request adjustments until the portrait feels like you. For ideas about creating a larger wall piece, explore our [Dragon Ball Z-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/dragon-ball-z-inspired-custom-poster).

A custom Dragon Ball Z portrait starts at $39.99, making it a memorable birthday surprise, anniversary present, convention keepsake or statement piece for a fan’s room. You can order a digital artwork or select a print option where available, depending on how you want to display it. The finished design captures the visual language of high-energy anime while preserving the details that make your family or friend group unmistakably yours. Looking for more present inspiration? Browse our [Dragon Ball Z fan gift guide](/blog/best-gifts-for-dragon-ball-z-fans), or visit the [Anime Cabinet homepage](/) to see all 24 hand-drawn anime and cartoon styles.

faqs.q: Where can I order a custom Dragon Ball Z portrait, and how much does it cost?
faqs.a: You can order a custom Dragon Ball Z portrait directly from this Anime Cabinet style page. Prices start at $39.99, with the final cost depending on the selected format, size and number of people. Each portrait is hand-drawn by a human artist, not produced with an AI filter. You receive a preview within 72 hours and unlimited free revisions are included.

faqs.q: How do I turn a photo into a custom Dragon Ball Z portrait, and what details should I provide?
faqs.a: Upload a clear photo during checkout, then add notes about the pose, clothing, hair, aura colour, background, preferred power-up mood and any important facial details. Label every person in a group image. You can commission a portrait of yourself, your family, a couple or friends, and multiple characters can be combined into one scene. The artist uses your references to create original DBZ-inspired characters while keeping faces recognisable and avoiding direct copyrighted-character impersonation.
